Name: Supply Flare
Description: A road flare for a raid. Pop it out in the open and a cargo plane drops a supply crate on the smoke: a guaranteed gun, ammo, medkits and more. The crate blares three times before it opens, and every Listener around comes to see.

Name: 15 Minutes as the Mother
Description: 15 minutes as the Mother. She only comes in a storm: when she does, the first to press BE HER gets her, from the menu (THE MOTHER) or out in town at full health (your loot goes to your stash). Up to 15 minutes a go. Walk through anything, roar, and bite the roofs off. Your time only runs while you're her; what's left is kept for the next storm.

Name: Quick Extract
Description: One Quick Extract. Press QUICK EXTRACT out in a raid and a beam comes down from the sky and lifts you out, with everything you're carrying. Works when you're knocked down, but not in a fight: not for 15 seconds after you get hurt, fire a shot, or are chased. If it can't be used right away, it's kept for you.

Name: Block with a Switch
Description: LIMITED: only 400 will ever be sold. The Block with a Switch goes straight into your stash: a blacked-out 9mm with a switch on the back of the slide, fully automatic, with a 50-round red drum, a laser sight and red tracers. Die in a raid with it and it's lost like any gun. When all 400 are gone, nobody else can buy one.

Name: R.A.T. Sedan Delivery
Description: R.A.T. flies a sedan in by cargo plane to the drop pad outside HAVEN OUTPOST, for the raid you're in. It lands locked and the key is yours (your party's too). Bought away from the outpost's radio, it's kept for you: call it in from the radio when you're there.
